content: गरिमन् {%m.%} .²1 Weight, heaviness; <ls>Śi. 9. 49</ls>. .²2 Importance, greatness, dignity; निरतिशयं गरिमाणं तेन जनन्याः स्मरन्ति विद्वांसः <ls>Pt. 1. 30</ls>. .²3 Worth, excellence. .²4 One of the eight {%siddhis%} or faculties of Śiva, by which he can make himself heavy or great at will; see सिद्धि.
